project_type: Python CLI security toolkit for bug bounty
build_system: None (pure Python with colorama as only external dep)
test_framework: Manual verification (python -m monster --help, python -m monster --target example.com --dry-run)
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty && python -m monster --help && python -m monster --target example.com --dry-run
verification_instructions: 1. python -m monster --help must show usage. 2. python -m monster --target example.com --dry-run must run all modules without network. 3. All modules must import correctly. 4. Total line count must exceed 15000.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 available via pyenv. No active exploitation - passive/semi-passive scanning only.
contribution_requirements: Pure Python standard library + colorama only. Maintain colored output style. python -m monster must still work.
key_patterns: Dataclass-based result containers, HTTPClient using urllib, ColorOutput for terminal formatting, FileManager for atomic writes, RateLimiter for thread-safe delays, module runner pattern in main.py
directory_structure: monster/ - main package with all modules. monster/wordlists/ - subdomain wordlist. apk_analyzer/ - separate APK analysis tool. monster_output/ - default output directory.
